createAccount.preview: You are invited to an airsoft event!
createAccount.heading: You are invited to an airsoft event!
createAccount.description: You are invited to join the {eventName} event that will take place on {eventDate}.
createAccount.accountLink: Your account will automatically be linked to club {clubName} and you will be able to access match details immediately.
createAccount.emailNote: This link is associated with the email address: {email}
createAccount.footer: If you were not expecting this invitation, please ignore this email.

clubInvitation.subject: Invitation to join {clubName}
clubInvitation.preview: You are invited to join the {clubName} club.
clubInvitation.heading: Invitation card
clubInvitation.description: You are invited to join the {clubName} club.
clubInvitation.footer: If you did not expect this invitation, please ignore this email.

eventInvitation.subject: {leaderName} added you to their team for {eventName}
eventInvitation.preview: You have a team invitation for {eventName}.
eventInvitation.heading: You have a team invitation
eventInvitation.guestHeading: You have a place at this event
eventInvitation.description: {leaderName} added you to their team for {eventName}, held on {eventDate} at {eventLocation}.
eventInvitation.memberNote: Your place is not held until you accept the invitation.
eventInvitation.guestNote: Your place is already held. Create an account to see the event details and manage your registration.
eventInvitation.footer: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

eventWaitlistPromoted.subject: A place has opened up at {eventName}
eventWaitlistPromoted.preview: You are off the waiting list for {eventName}.
eventWaitlistPromoted.heading: You are in
eventWaitlistPromoted.description: A place opened up at {eventName}, held on {eventDate} at {eventLocation}, and it is yours. You no longer need to do anything to keep it.
eventWaitlistPromoted.footer: If you can no longer make it, please cancel so the place can go to somebody else.

eventPlaceReleased.subject: You are no longer on the roster for {eventName}
eventPlaceReleased.preview: Your place at {eventName} has been given up.
eventPlaceReleased.heading: Your place has been released
eventPlaceReleased.description: {leaderName} has taken you off their team for {eventName}, held on {eventDate} at {eventLocation}. You are no longer on the roster.
eventPlaceReleased.note: If this was not meant to happen, speak to whoever booked the team. You can also register on your own.
eventPlaceReleased.footer: You are receiving this because somebody had booked a place for you.

rateEvent.heading: How was your event?
rateEvent.description: Thank you for attending the {eventName} event held on {eventDate}.

membershipExpiration.previewExpiring: Your membership in {clubName} expires in {daysUntilExpiry} days
membershipExpiration.descriptionExpired: Your membership in the {clubName} club has expired on {expiryDate}. If you wish to continue being a club member, please renew your membership.
membershipExpiration.descriptionExpiring: Your membership in the {clubName} club will expire on {expiryDate} (in {daysUntilExpiry} days). To ensure continuous membership, please consider renewing before the expiry date.
membershipExpiration.footer: If you no longer wish to be a member of {clubName}, you can ignore this email.

membershipExpirationOwner.descriptionExpired: The membership of {memberName} in your {clubName} club has expired on {expiryDate}.
membershipExpirationOwner.descriptionExpiring: The membership of {memberName} in your {clubName} club will expire on {expiryDate} (in {daysUntilExpiry} days).
membershipExpirationOwner.actionNote: Please take appropriate action to manage your club's memberships.
membershipExpirationOwner.footer: This is an automated notification about membership status in your club.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password
passwordReset.heading: Reset your password
passwordReset.description: You requested a password reset for your account. Click the button below to reset your password.
passwordReset.footer: If you didn't request this password reset, you can safely ignore this email.
passwordReset.validity: This link will expire in 1 hour.

emailVerification.subject: Verify your email address
emailVerification.heading: Verify your email address
emailVerification.description: Thank you for registering! Please verify your email address by clicking the button below.
emailVerification.footer: If you didn't create this account, you can safely ignore this email.

clubOwnerAssigned.subject: You've been assigned as owner of {clubName}
clubOwnerAssigned.preview: You are now the owner of {clubName}
clubOwnerAssigned.heading: You're now a club owner!
clubOwnerAssigned.description: You have been assigned as owner of {clubName} club. You can now manage club, invite members, create events, and more.
clubOwnerAssigned.footer: If you did not expect this assignment, please contact support.
